text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type with somatic delusion of lost telepathic ability.

The patient describes a specific inability to communicate telepathically with animals, a belief he held previously, now worsening over eight months and influenced by weather. He has sought treatment with unproven Peruvian herbs with no relief. I will proceed to assess if this is a primary psychotic disorder or a manifestation of an underlying organic condition.
